## Textbook practice {#practice .psf-lesson}

CambridgeMATHS NSW Year 10, Stage 5 Core & Advanced/Extension Paths, third edition (2024). **Exercise 5D.**

:::: {.psf-practice}

::: {}

For the first set:

1. Record P and S.
2. Predict the signs.
3. List the signed pairs.
4. Circle the pair with the target sum.

:::

| Time | Core practice |
|:--|:--|
| 8 min | p. 381, Q1(a, b, d, m). Compare (a) with (b), then (d) with (m). |
| 12 min | p. 381, Q1(h, v, q, k, t, w). Work in this order. Check both product and sum before writing the brackets. |
| 8 min | p. 381, Q2(a, e, h). Take out the common factor first. In (h), take out a negative factor. |
| 7 min | p. 381, Q1(p, r), then p. 382, Q3(h). Factorise fully. Look for repeated factors. |
| 5 min | Check on p. 908. Redo a missed question. If all are correct, expand your answer to Q2(h) and check all three signs. |
